mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a more accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is continuously active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200.0) signals potential monetary tightening and recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 200.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5) and rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 134000) signals a tight labor market that precedes Federal Reserve rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 4.5 and PAYEMS > 134000 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 11200.0 and INDPRO < 110.0), housing starts (HOUST) below 2300 thousand units signal economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 > 11200.0, INDPRO < 110.0, and HOUST < 2300.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This signal is continuously active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO is below 110.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 2300 thousand units signal housing market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 2300.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary policy error, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This signal is continuously active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
